text: Landed in 03ac76e, each with its tests and a -landed line in meta_agent/failures.jsonl: office-1 (make writes each bundle file as its blob's bytes through git ls-tree and cat-file, so core.autocrlf and attributes touch nothing), office-3 (a link WSL writes on NTFS is read from its reparse data and hashed as a link; a link to a folder is passed over as elsewhere), office-4 (seat_commit compares resolved paths, 8.3 names included, and a path on another drive is outside; read-only files are removed), office-5 (no git init -b in contracts/tests; validate.py imported without jsonschema raises ImportError and does not relaunch), office-7's design part (wipe and tree_hashes read paths past Windows' limit; the Designer's clean-up stays the meta role's), office-11 (wipe removes read-only files, writes wiping.json first and the run's mark last, so a stopped wipe is run again with its record; status passes over a collection with no collection.json). contracts/tests pass on Windows here; in WSL nothing fails from git 2.25, but the suite needs jsonschema 4 or later, which WSL's system Python (3.2.0) lacks and uv's offline cache does not hold: a download that is the person's to allow. Line endings: office-2 now shows as a refusal on every computer, since make copies the tree as committed. A rule is needed, and it is the meta role's builder and this repository's attributes together: every file a tool writes for a card's digest is written with newline='\n' (Python's text mode writes CRLF on Windows; bootstrap.py seat does too, git warned on contracts/seats.json), and the repository gets a .gitattributes of '* text=auto eol=lf' so a Windows checkout holds LF files and a digest of the working tree equals one of the commit. I have not added the .gitattributes: it renormalises every checkout and is a repository-wide change I would land only with the meta role's builder change beside it; say if you want it now.
